authenticity_review: Significant structural artifacts undermine physical plausibility. The leftmost cat exhibits severe fusion with the adjacent candle base; the boundary between fur and wax is blurred and indistinct, violating object permanence. The second candle from the left also shows boundary ambiguity where it meets the first cat. Additionally, the rightmost cat displays facial asymmetry and texture melting around the eyes/mouth. The animal_pose_auditor reported a MEDIUM artifact risk level (32% low-confidence keypoints), particularly in hind limbs and face regions, corroborating these visual defects. While lighting and composition are aesthetically coherent, the physical boundary failures are substantial.
key_defects: Spatial inversion: Cats are in front of candles (prompt requested opposite)
Object fusion: Leftmost cat merges physically with candle base
Boundary ambiguity: Second candle blends into adjacent cat
Facial distortion: Rightmost cat shows asymmetry and texture melting
